parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: zh-CN (default): Chinese, en-US: English

parameters.name: AuthRule
parameters.description: The content of the service authentication rule.

parameters.name: AuthType
parameters.description:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

- 0: by application.

- 1: by namespace.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the authentication rule. Valid values:

- `true`: enabled.

- `false`: disabled.

parameters.name: K8sNamespace
parameters.description: The ID of the namespace in the Kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The MSE namespace to which the application belongs.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The source. The value can be \`edasmsc\`.
